indexDefinition: CREATE INDEX memberships_renewal_window_idx ON public.memberships USING btree (billing_period_end, id) WHERE ((billing_period_end IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::membership_status, 'past_due'::membership_status])) AND (cancel_at_period_end = false) AND (billing_interval <> 'none'::billing_interval) AND (grant_effective_at IS NULL) AND (grant_expires_at IS NULL))
